profile.name: Expert Dewatering Engineering Configuration
profile.basis: Engineering template - replace all values with site-verified data before pilot/operations use.

pilot.label: Expert dewatering config (advisory/read-only)
pilot.notes: Advisory configuration only. No automatic plant control. Validate against P&IDs, pump curves, sump surveys, protection settings, and operating procedures.

designBasis.calculationMethod: Mass balance / system curve intersection (modelled, deterministic)

sumps.basis: Template - set from surveyed volume, freeboard, pump NPSH, and overflow consequences

pumps.basis: Template - align to OEM curve, motor thermal limits, and site duty

pipelines.basis: Template - confirm material class, wear allowance, and surge limits

alertSetpoints.notes: Use to generate platform alert rules; verify against site alarm philosophy and cause/effect.

requiredChecks: Verify sensor tag mapping, scaling, units, and timestamp source
Validate sump level survey/volume curve against as-built
Confirm pump curve, efficiency, and motor nameplate inputs
Backtest against historical period with known events
Review alarm setpoints with operations and safety
Document provenance (measured/estimated/synthetic) for every critical input
